title: G's Music
description: Full-screen Spotify player for the touch screen: album art, synced lyrics (LRCLIB) or a visualizer, a progress bar you tap or drag to seek, and big touch controls (previous, play/pause, next, shuffle, repeat, like) over the Spotify Web API; sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone; and a home-screen widget (album art, title and artist of what plays; the track as text on the small size); while a track plays, its synced lyrics or a visualizer in the instrument cluster's centre map area (needs the Cluster renderer from the Store; hidden while G's TV plays there or a route is guided; 0.6.1: follows G's Dash's Cluster source pick, showing only for Auto and Music); needs Spotify Premium and mgu-uplink internet

startWidget.comment: Home-screen widget, as G's Dash's (same layout: BMW's Drive Recorder widget on this firmware, upstream's apps/edrive). The big size is a picture main.js draws and pushes into BackgroundImage1 while the app runs: the album art with the title, artist and a progress line, or with nothing playing the G's Music logo (widget_logo.js from tools/make_gsmusic_icon.py). Everything sits centred inside 'safe' (share of width / height kept clear on each side: the HMI crops the edges and draws a dark vignette over them). The small size shows no pictures, so main.js writes the track into its text lines (Title, TextRecordings, TextCam, the progress bar, TimeRemaining), or the app's name; the cells below are the values on placement.
startWidget.name: G's Music

de.bmw.infotainment.navigation.navigatio._optional: the cluster picture's route guidance check: guidingState (ACTIVE hides the lyrics / visualizer in the cluster); without it the picture goes by the phone's signals, and with none it also shows during a route

de.bmw.infotainment.a4a.carplay.CarPlayM._optional: the cluster picture's CarPlay route guidance check (Waze or Maps with a route): projectedGuidanceActive

de.bmw.infotainment.sdi.aap.androidautop._optional: the cluster picture's Android Auto route guidance check: projectedGuidanceActive

_retiredSettings: settings 0.5.0 had and 0.5.1 dropped: a saved value is deleted on start (kit/runtime/mgu.js). Spotify is polled every 3 s, the renderer is always the GPU one, no demo data.
